public_rationale: On June 10, 2026, Reuters relayed a Wall Street Journal report that OpenAI was considering drastic price cuts, potentially for tokens; discussions remained in flux, and Reuters could not independently verify the report [e1]. This item does not establish Anthropic’s own pricing plans, substantial customer resistance, or a causal link between resistance and contemplated cuts at both companies by June 15, 2026 [e1]. It also does not establish a material breakdown of the subsidized-usage model, leaving the full claim unresolved [e1].
limitations: The original Wall Street Journal article was inaccessible; the available evidence is Reuters’ unverified account of that reporting.
The packet does not measure customer complaints, spending reductions, cancellations, switching, or a material breakdown of the business model.
The packet does not establish the size of contemplated cuts or Anthropic’s own deliberations.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The AI tokenomics bubble is bursting because Anthropic's and OpenAI's customers are revolting against costs, prompting planned drastic price cuts.

statement.excerpt: And now it’s bursting because Anthropic and OpenAI’s customers are in revolt, to the point that they’re planning “drastic” price cuts.

from_speaker: Anthropic and OpenAI’s customers are in revolt
our_interpretation: Read 'customers are in revolt' as substantial customer resistance to usage costs, expressed through complaints, spending controls, cancellations, or switching.
Read 'bursting' as a material breakdown of the subsidized-usage business model described in the surrounding passage, not necessarily corporate failure.
The claim requires customer resistance to have materially prompted contemplated large price reductions at both companies by June 15, 2026. Implemented cuts are not required.
criteria.support_condition: Dated customer records and company statements or well-sourced reporting establish substantial resistance, contemplated large cuts at both companies, and a causal connection between them. Evidence also establishes the claimed material breakdown.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Direct evidence establishes that the asserted pricing plans did not exist, or that the claimed customer resistance and resulting breakdown did not occur. Evidence of competition alone would not exclude customer resistance as another cause.
